# Deriving SDFs: Shaders

Complete, runnable shaders for each demo in the deriving-sdfs chapter.
13 demos total.

---

## infinite-cylinder

Raymarched infinite cylinder along y-axis. `shadeNormal`, single shape in the void.
Demonstrates "ignoring a coordinate."

```glsl
const int MAX_STEPS = 100;
const float MAX_DIST = 100.0;
const float HIT_THRESHOLD = 0.001;

struct Ray {
    vec3 origin;
    vec3 dir;
};

Ray makeRay(vec2 fragCoord) {
    vec2 uv = (fragCoord / iResolution.xy) * 2.0 - 1.0;
    uv.x *= iResolution.x / iResolution.y;

    float fov = 90.0;
    float f = 1.0 / tan(radians(fov) / 2.0);

    Ray ray;
    ray.origin = vec3(0.0);
    ray.dir = normalize(vec3(uv, -f));
    return ray;
}

mat3 rotateX(float a) {
    float c = cos(a), s = sin(a);
    return mat3(1, 0, 0, 0, c, -s, 0, s, c);
}

mat3 rotateY(float a) {
    float c = cos(a), s = sin(a);
    return mat3(c, 0, s, 0, 1, 0, -s, 0, c);
}

Ray orbitRay(Ray ray, float distance) {
    vec2 mouse = iMouse.xy / iResolution.xy;
    if (length(iMouse.xy) < 1.0) mouse = vec2(0.6, 0.55);

    float angleY = (mouse.x - 0.5) * 6.28;
    float angleX = (0.5 - mouse.y) * 3.14;

    mat3 rot = rotateX(angleX) * rotateY(angleY);
    ray.origin = rot * vec3(0.0, 0.0, distance);
    ray.dir = rot * ray.dir;
    return ray;
}

// --- Scene ---

float sdScene(vec3 p) {
    return length(p.xz) - 1.0;
}

// --- Raymarching ---

vec3 calcNormal(vec3 p) {
    float eps = 0.001;
    return normalize(vec3(
        sdScene(p + vec3(eps, 0, 0)) - sdScene(p - vec3(eps, 0, 0)),
        sdScene(p + vec3(0, eps, 0)) - sdScene(p - vec3(0, eps, 0)),
        sdScene(p + vec3(0, 0, eps)) - sdScene(p - vec3(0, 0, eps))
    ));
}

float raymarch(Ray ray) {
    float t = 0.0;

    for (int i = 0; i < MAX_STEPS; i++) {
        vec3 p = ray.origin + t * ray.dir;
        float d = sdScene(p);

        if (d < HIT_THRESHOLD) return t;

        t += d;

        if (t > MAX_DIST) return -1.0;
    }

    return -1.0;
}

// --- Shading ---

vec3 shadeNormal(vec3 normal) {
    return normal * 0.5 + 0.5;
}

void mainImage(out vec4 fragColor, in vec2 fragCoord) {
    Ray ray = makeRay(fragCoord);
    ray = orbitRay(ray, 4.0);

    float t = raymarch(ray);

    vec3 color = vec3(0.1, 0.1, 0.2);
    if (t > 0.0) {
        vec3 p = ray.origin + t * ray.dir;
        vec3 normal = calcNormal(p);
        color = shadeNormal(normal);
    }

    fragColor = vec4(color, 1.0);
}
```

## box-regions

2D box with three regions colored differently: corner (red), edge (green), inside (blue).
Contour lines and zero set on top.

```glsl
float sdBox(vec2 p, vec2 halfSize) {
    vec2 q = abs(p) - halfSize;
    return length(max(q, 0.0)) + min(max(q.x, q.y), 0.0);
}

void mainImage(out vec4 fragColor, in vec2 fragCoord) {
    vec2 uv = (fragCoord / iResolution.xy) * 2.0 - 1.0;
    uv.x *= iResolution.x / iResolution.y;
    vec2 p = uv * 3.0;

    vec2 halfSize = vec2(1.0, 0.6);
    float d = sdBox(p, halfSize);

    // Classify region using the excess vector
    vec2 q = abs(p) - halfSize;

    vec3 color;
    if (q.x > 0.0 && q.y > 0.0) {
        // Corner region
        color = vec3(0.85, 0.3, 0.25);
    } else if (q.x > 0.0 || q.y > 0.0) {
        // Edge region
        color = vec3(0.3, 0.7, 0.3);
    } else {
        // Inside
        color = vec3(0.2, 0.4, 0.8);
    }

    // Darken near the boundary
    color *= 1.0 - exp(-6.0 * abs(d));

    // Contour lines
    float contour = abs(fract(d * 4.0 + 0.5) - 0.5);
    color = mix(vec3(1.0), color, smoothstep(0.0, 0.05, contour));

    // Highlight the zero level set
    color = mix(vec3(1.0), color, smoothstep(0.0, 0.02, abs(d)));

    fragColor = vec4(color, 1.0);
}
```

## box-2d

Standard 2D SDF visualization of a box.

```glsl
float sdBox(vec2 p, vec2 halfSize) {
    vec2 q = abs(p) - halfSize;
    return length(max(q, 0.0)) + min(max(q.x, q.y), 0.0);
}

void mainImage(out vec4 fragColor, in vec2 fragCoord) {
    vec2 uv = (fragCoord / iResolution.xy) * 2.0 - 1.0;
    uv.x *= iResolution.x / iResolution.y;
    vec2 p = uv * 3.0;

    float d = sdBox(p, vec2(1.0, 0.6));

    // Color by sign: blue inside, orange outside
    vec3 color;
    if (d < 0.0) {
        color = vec3(0.2, 0.4, 0.8);
    } else {
        color = vec3(0.9, 0.6, 0.2);
    }

    // Darken near the boundary
    color *= 1.0 - exp(-6.0 * abs(d));

    // Contour lines
    float contour = abs(fract(d * 4.0 + 0.5) - 0.5);
    color = mix(vec3(1.0), color, smoothstep(0.0, 0.05, contour));

    // Highlight the zero level set
    color = mix(vec3(1.0), color, smoothstep(0.0, 0.02, abs(d)));

    fragColor = vec4(color, 1.0);
}
```

## torus

Raymarched torus, `shadeNormal`. Single shape in the void.

```glsl
const int MAX_STEPS = 100;
const float MAX_DIST = 100.0;
const float HIT_THRESHOLD = 0.001;

struct Ray {
    vec3 origin;
    vec3 dir;
};

Ray makeRay(vec2 fragCoord) {
    vec2 uv = (fragCoord / iResolution.xy) * 2.0 - 1.0;
    uv.x *= iResolution.x / iResolution.y;

    float f = 1.0 / tan(radians(fov) / 2.0);

    Ray ray;
    ray.origin = vec3(0.0);
    ray.dir = normalize(vec3(uv, -f));
    return ray;
}

mat3 rotateX(float a) {
    float c = cos(a), s = sin(a);
    return mat3(1, 0, 0, 0, c, -s, 0, s, c);
}

mat3 rotateY(float a) {
    float c = cos(a), s = sin(a);
    return mat3(c, 0, s, 0, 1, 0, -s, 0, c);
}

Ray orbitRay(Ray ray, float distance) {
    vec2 mouse = iMouse.xy / iResolution.xy;
    if (length(iMouse.xy) < 1.0) mouse = vec2(0.6, 0.55);

    float angleY = (mouse.x - 0.5) * 6.28;
    float angleX = (0.5 - mouse.y) * 3.14;

    ray.origin = rot * vec3(0.0, 0.0, distance);
    ray.dir = rot * ray.dir;
    return ray;

float sdTorus(vec3 p, float R, float r) {

    for (int i = 0; i < MAX_STEPS; i++) {

        float d = sdScene(p);

        if (d < HIT_THRESHOLD) return t;

        t += d;

        if (t > MAX_DIST) return -1.0;
    }

    return -1.0;
}

// --- Shading ---

vec3 shadeNormal(vec3 normal) {
    return normal * 0.5 + 0.5;
}

    Ray ray = makeRay(fragCoord);
    ray = orbitRay(ray, 5.0);

    float t = raymarch(ray);

    vec3 color = vec3(0.1, 0.1, 0.2);
    if (t > 0.0) {
        vec3 p = ray.origin + t * ray.dir;
        vec3 normal = calcNormal(p);
        color = shadeNormal(normal);
```

## cylinder

Raymarched capped cylinder, `shadeNormal`. Single shape in the void.

```glsl
const int MAX_STEPS = 100;
const float MAX_DIST = 100.0;
const float HIT_THRESHOLD = 0.001;

struct Ray {
    vec3 origin;
    vec3 dir;
};

Ray makeRay(vec2 fragCoord) {
    vec2 uv = (fragCoord / iResolution.xy) * 2.0 - 1.0;
    uv.x *= iResolution.x / iResolution.y;

    float fov = 90.0;
    float f = 1.0 / tan(radians(fov) / 2.0);

    Ray ray;
    ray.origin = vec3(0.0);
    ray.dir = normalize(vec3(uv, -f));
    return ray;
}

mat3 rotateX(float a) {
    float c = cos(a), s = sin(a);
    return mat3(1, 0, 0, 0, c, -s, 0, s, c);
}

mat3 rotateY(float a) {
    float c = cos(a), s = sin(a);
    return mat3(c, 0, s, 0, 1, 0, -s, 0, c);
}

Ray orbitRay(Ray ray, float distance) {
    vec2 mouse = iMouse.xy / iResolution.xy;
    if (length(iMouse.xy) < 1.0) mouse = vec2(0.6, 0.55);

    float angleY = (mouse.x - 0.5) * 6.28;
    float angleX = (0.5 - mouse.y) * 3.14;

    mat3 rot = rotateX(angleX) * rotateY(angleY);
    ray.origin = rot * vec3(0.0, 0.0, distance);
    ray.dir = rot * ray.dir;
    return ray;
}

// --- Scene ---

float sdCylinder(vec3 p, float r, float h) {
    vec2 d = vec2(length(p.xz) - r, abs(p.y) - h);
    return length(max(d, 0.0)) + min(max(d.x, d.y), 0.0);

    return -1.0;
}

// --- Shading ---

    return normal * 0.5 + 0.5;
}

    Ray ray = makeRay(fragCoord);
    ray = orbitRay(ray, 4.0);

    float t = raymarch(ray);

    vec3 color = vec3(0.1, 0.1, 0.2);
    if (t > 0.0) {
        vec3 p = ray.origin + t * ray.dir;
        vec3 normal = calcNormal(p);
        color = shadeNormal(normal);
```

## cone

Raymarched infinite cone, `shadeNormal`. Single shape in the void.
Apex at origin, opening downward, half-angle 0.5 rad (~28.6°).

```glsl
const int MAX_STEPS = 100;
const float MAX_DIST = 100.0;
const float HIT_THRESHOLD = 0.001;

struct Ray {
    vec3 origin;
    vec3 dir;
};

Ray makeRay(vec2 fragCoord) {
    vec2 uv = (fragCoord / iResolution.xy) * 2.0 - 1.0;
    uv.x *= iResolution.x / iResolution.y;

    float fov = 90.0;
    float f = 1.0 / tan(radians(fov) / 2.0);

    Ray ray;
    ray.origin = vec3(0.0);
    ray.dir = normalize(vec3(uv, -f));
    return ray;
}

mat3 rotateX(float a) {
    float c = cos(a), s = sin(a);
    return mat3(1, 0, 0, 0, c, -s, 0, s, c);
}

mat3 rotateY(float a) {
    float c = cos(a), s = sin(a);
    return mat3(c, 0, s, 0, 1, 0, -s, 0, c);
}

Ray orbitRay(Ray ray, float distance) {
    vec2 mouse = iMouse.xy / iResolution.xy;
    if (length(iMouse.xy) < 1.0) mouse = vec2(0.6, 0.55);

    float angleY = (mouse.x - 0.5) * 6.28;
    float angleX = (0.5 - mouse.y) * 3.14;

    mat3 rot = rotateX(angleX) * rotateY(angleY);
    ray.origin = rot * vec3(0.0, 0.0, distance);
    ray.dir = rot * ray.dir;
    return ray;
}

// --- Scene ---

float sdCone(vec3 p, float angle) {
    vec2 q = vec2(length(p.xz), p.y);
    vec2 n = vec2(cos(angle), sin(angle));
    return dot(q, n);
}

float sdScene(vec3 p) {
    return sdCone(p, 0.5);
}

// --- Raymarching ---

vec3 calcNormal(vec3 p) {
    float eps = 0.001;
    return normalize(vec3(
        sdScene(p + vec3(eps, 0, 0)) - sdScene(p - vec3(eps, 0, 0)),
        sdScene(p + vec3(0, eps, 0)) - sdScene(p - vec3(0, eps, 0)),
        sdScene(p + vec3(0, 0, eps)) - sdScene(p - vec3(0, 0, eps))
    ));
}

float raymarch(Ray ray) {
    float t = 0.0;

    for (int i = 0; i < MAX_STEPS; i++) {
        vec3 p = ray.origin + t * ray.dir;
        float d = sdScene(p);

        if (d < HIT_THRESHOLD) return t;

        t += d;

        if (t > MAX_DIST) return -1.0;
    }

    return -1.0;
}

// --- Shading ---

vec3 shadeNormal(vec3 normal) {
    return normal * 0.5 + 0.5;
}

void mainImage(out vec4 fragColor, in vec2 fragCoord) {
    Ray ray = makeRay(fragCoord);
    ray = orbitRay(ray, 5.0);

    float t = raymarch(ray);

    vec3 color = vec3(0.1, 0.1, 0.2);
    if (t > 0.0) {
        vec3 p = ray.origin + t * ray.dir;
        vec3 normal = calcNormal(p);
        color = shadeNormal(normal);
    }

    fragColor = vec4(color, 1.0);
}
```

## capsule

Raymarched capsule, `shadeNormal`. Single shape in the void.

```glsl
const int MAX_STEPS = 100;
const float MAX_DIST = 100.0;
const float HIT_THRESHOLD = 0.001;

struct Ray {
    vec3 origin;
    vec3 dir;
};

Ray makeRay(vec2 fragCoord) {
    vec2 uv = (fragCoord / iResolution.xy) * 2.0 - 1.0;
    uv.x *= iResolution.x / iResolution.y;

    float fov = 90.0;
    float f = 1.0 / tan(radians(fov) / 2.0);

    Ray ray;
    ray.origin = vec3(0.0);
    ray.dir = normalize(vec3(uv, -f));
    return ray;
}

mat3 rotateX(float a) {
    float c = cos(a), s = sin(a);
    return mat3(1, 0, 0, 0, c, -s, 0, s, c);
}

mat3 rotateY(float a) {
    float c = cos(a), s = sin(a);
    return mat3(c, 0, s, 0, 1, 0, -s, 0, c);
}

Ray orbitRay(Ray ray, float distance) {
    vec2 mouse = iMouse.xy / iResolution.xy;
    if (length(iMouse.xy) < 1.0) mouse = vec2(0.6, 0.55);

    float angleY = (mouse.x - 0.5) * 6.28;
    float angleX = (0.5 - mouse.y) * 3.14;

    mat3 rot = rotateX(angleX) * rotateY(angleY);
    ray.origin = rot * vec3(0.0, 0.0, distance);
    ray.dir = rot * ray.dir;
    return ray;
}

// --- Scene ---

float sdCapsule(vec3 p, vec3 a, vec3 b, float r) {
    vec3 pa = p - a, ba = b - a;
    float t = clamp(dot(pa, ba) / dot(ba, ba), 0.0, 1.0);
    return length(pa - ba * t) - r;
}

float sdScene(vec3 p) {
    return sdCapsule(p, vec3(-0.8, -0.5, 0.0), vec3(0.8, 0.5, 0.3), 0.35);
}

// --- Raymarching ---

vec3 calcNormal(vec3 p) {
    float eps = 0.001;
    return normalize(vec3(
        sdScene(p + vec3(eps, 0, 0)) - sdScene(p - vec3(eps, 0, 0)),
        sdScene(p + vec3(0, eps, 0)) - sdScene(p - vec3(0, eps, 0)),
        sdScene(p + vec3(0, 0, eps)) - sdScene(p - vec3(0, 0, eps))
    ));
}

float raymarch(Ray ray) {
    float t = 0.0;

    for (int i = 0; i < MAX_STEPS; i++) {
        vec3 p = ray.origin + t * ray.dir;
        float d = sdScene(p);

        if (d < HIT_THRESHOLD) return t;

        t += d;

        if (t > MAX_DIST) return -1.0;
    }

    return -1.0;
}

// --- Shading ---

vec3 shadeNormal(vec3 normal) {
    return normal * 0.5 + 0.5;
}

void mainImage(out vec4 fragColor, in vec2 fragCoord) {
    Ray ray = makeRay(fragCoord);
    ray = orbitRay(ray, 4.0);

    float t = raymarch(ray);

    vec3 color = vec3(0.1, 0.1, 0.2);
    if (t > 0.0) {
        vec3 p = ray.origin + t * ray.dir;
        vec3 normal = calcNormal(p);
        color = shadeNormal(normal);
    }

    fragColor = vec4(color, 1.0);
}
```

## triangle-2d

2D SDF visualization of equilateral triangle via symmetry folding.

```glsl
float sdTriangle(vec2 p, float r) {
    p.x = abs(p.x);
    p -= 2.0 * min(dot(p, vec2(-0.5, -sqrt(3.0) / 2.0)), 0.0)
             * vec2(-0.5, -sqrt(3.0) / 2.0);
    p.x = abs(p.x);

    return -(p.y + r * 0.5);
}

void mainImage(out vec4 fragColor, in vec2 fragCoord) {
    vec2 uv = (fragCoord / iResolution.xy) * 2.0 - 1.0;
    uv.x *= iResolution.x / iResolution.y;
    vec2 p = uv * 3.0;

    float d = sdTriangle(p, 2.0);

    // Color by sign: blue inside, orange outside
    vec3 color;
    if (d < 0.0) {
        color = vec3(0.2, 0.4, 0.8);
    } else {
        color = vec3(0.9, 0.6, 0.2);
    }

    // Darken near the boundary
    color *= 1.0 - exp(-6.0 * abs(d));

    // Contour lines
    float contour = abs(fract(d * 4.0 + 0.5) - 0.5);
    color = mix(vec3(1.0), color, smoothstep(0.0, 0.05, contour));

    // Highlight the zero level set
    color = mix(vec3(1.0), color, smoothstep(0.0, 0.02, abs(d)));

    fragColor = vec4(color, 1.0);
}
```

## octahedron

Raymarched octahedron via `abs` folding, `shadeNormal`. Single shape in the void.

```glsl
const int MAX_STEPS = 100;
const float MAX_DIST = 100.0;
const float HIT_THRESHOLD = 0.001;

struct Ray {
    vec3 origin;
    vec3 dir;
};

Ray makeRay(vec2 fragCoord) {
    vec2 uv = (fragCoord / iResolution.xy) * 2.0 - 1.0;
    uv.x *= iResolution.x / iResolution.y;

    float fov = 90.0;
    float f = 1.0 / tan(radians(fov) / 2.0);

    Ray ray;
    ray.origin = vec3(0.0);
    ray.dir = normalize(vec3(uv, -f));
    return ray;
}

mat3 rotateX(float a) {
    float c = cos(a), s = sin(a);
    return mat3(1, 0, 0, 0, c, -s, 0, s, c);
}

mat3 rotateY(float a) {
    float c = cos(a), s = sin(a);
    return mat3(c, 0, s, 0, 1, 0, -s, 0, c);
}

Ray orbitRay(Ray ray, float distance) {
    vec2 mouse = iMouse.xy / iResolution.xy;
    if (length(iMouse.xy) < 1.0) mouse = vec2(0.6, 0.55);

    float angleY = (mouse.x - 0.5) * 6.28;
    float angleX = (0.5 - mouse.y) * 3.14;

    mat3 rot = rotateX(angleX) * rotateY(angleY);
    ray.origin = rot * vec3(0.0, 0.0, distance);
    ray.dir = rot * ray.dir;
    return ray;
}

// --- Scene ---

float sdOctahedron(vec3 p, float s) {
    p = abs(p);
    return (p.x + p.y + p.z - s) * 0.57735027;
}

float sdScene(vec3 p) {
    return sdOctahedron(p, 1.0);
}

// --- Raymarching ---

vec3 calcNormal(vec3 p) {
    float eps = 0.001;
    return normalize(vec3(
        sdScene(p + vec3(eps, 0, 0)) - sdScene(p - vec3(eps, 0, 0)),
        sdScene(p + vec3(0, eps, 0)) - sdScene(p - vec3(0, eps, 0)),
        sdScene(p + vec3(0, 0, eps)) - sdScene(p - vec3(0, 0, eps))
    ));
}

float raymarch(Ray ray) {
    float t = 0.0;

    for (int i = 0; i < MAX_STEPS; i++) {
        vec3 p = ray.origin + t * ray.dir;
        float d = sdScene(p);

        if (d < HIT_THRESHOLD) return t;

        t += d;

        if (t > MAX_DIST) return -1.0;
    }

    return -1.0;
}

// --- Shading ---

vec3 shadeNormal(vec3 normal) {
    return normal * 0.5 + 0.5;
}

void mainImage(out vec4 fragColor, in vec2 fragCoord) {
    Ray ray = makeRay(fragCoord);
    ray = orbitRay(ray, 4.0);

    float t = raymarch(ray);

    vec3 color = vec3(0.1, 0.1, 0.2);
    if (t > 0.0) {
        vec3 p = ray.origin + t * ray.dir;
        vec3 normal = calcNormal(p);
        color = shadeNormal(normal);
    }

    fragColor = vec4(color, 1.0);
}
```

## icosahedron

Raymarched icosahedron via golden-ratio reflections, `shadeNormal`.
Single shape in the void.

```glsl
const int MAX_STEPS = 100;
const float MAX_DIST = 100.0;
const float HIT_THRESHOLD = 0.001;

struct Ray {
    vec3 origin;
    vec3 dir;
};

Ray makeRay(vec2 fragCoord) {
    vec2 uv = (fragCoord / iResolution.xy) * 2.0 - 1.0;
    uv.x *= iResolution.x / iResolution.y;

    float fov = 90.0;
    float f = 1.0 / tan(radians(fov) / 2.0);

    Ray ray;
    ray.origin = vec3(0.0);
    ray.dir = normalize(vec3(uv, -f));
    return ray;
}

mat3 rotateX(float a) {
    float c = cos(a), s = sin(a);
    return mat3(1, 0, 0, 0, c, -s, 0, s, c);
}

mat3 rotateY(float a) {
    float c = cos(a), s = sin(a);
    return mat3(c, 0, s, 0, 1, 0, -s, 0, c);
}

Ray orbitRay(Ray ray, float distance) {
    vec2 mouse = iMouse.xy / iResolution.xy;
    if (length(iMouse.xy) < 1.0) mouse = vec2(0.6, 0.55);

    float angleY = (mouse.x - 0.5) * 6.28;
    float angleX = (0.5 - mouse.y) * 3.14;

    mat3 rot = rotateX(angleX) * rotateY(angleY);
    ray.origin = rot * vec3(0.0, 0.0, distance);
    ray.dir = rot * ray.dir;
    return ray;
}

// --- Scene ---

#define PHI (0.5 + 0.5 * sqrt(5.0))

float sdIcosahedron(vec3 p, float r) {
    p = abs(p);
    float invPHI = PHI - 1.0;

    float d = p.x + p.y + p.z;
    d = max(d, p.y * invPHI + p.z * PHI);
    d = max(d, p.x * invPHI + p.y * PHI);
    d = max(d, p.x * PHI + p.z * invPHI);

    return d * 0.57735027 - r;
}

float sdScene(vec3 p) {
    return sdIcosahedron(p, 1.2);
}

// --- Raymarching ---

vec3 calcNormal(vec3 p) {
    float eps = 0.001;
    return normalize(vec3(
        sdScene(p + vec3(eps, 0, 0)) - sdScene(p - vec3(eps, 0, 0)),
        sdScene(p + vec3(0, eps, 0)) - sdScene(p - vec3(0, eps, 0)),
        sdScene(p + vec3(0, 0, eps)) - sdScene(p - vec3(0, 0, eps))
    ));
}

float raymarch(Ray ray) {
    float t = 0.0;

    for (int i = 0; i < MAX_STEPS; i++) {
        vec3 p = ray.origin + t * ray.dir;
        float d = sdScene(p);

        if (d < HIT_THRESHOLD) return t;

        t += d;

        if (t > MAX_DIST) return -1.0;
    }

    return -1.0;
}

// --- Shading ---

vec3 shadeNormal(vec3 normal) {
    return normal * 0.5 + 0.5;
}

void mainImage(out vec4 fragColor, in vec2 fragCoord) {
    Ray ray = makeRay(fragCoord);
    ray = orbitRay(ray, 4.0);

    float t = raymarch(ray);

    vec3 color = vec3(0.1, 0.1, 0.2);
    if (t > 0.0) {
        vec3 p = ray.origin + t * ray.dir;
        vec3 normal = calcNormal(p);
        color = shadeNormal(normal);
    }

    fragColor = vec4(color, 1.0);
}
```

## objects-scene

Sphere + icosahedron + ground plane. Full pattern with structs,
overloaded `sdf()`, `getMaterial`, `shadeDiffuse`.

```glsl
const int MAX_STEPS = 100;
const float MAX_DIST = 100.0;
const float HIT_THRESHOLD = 0.001;

struct Ray {
    vec3 origin;
    vec3 dir;
};

Ray makeRay(vec2 fragCoord) {
    vec2 uv = (fragCoord / iResolution.xy) * 2.0 - 1.0;
    uv.x *= iResolution.x / iResolution.y;

    float fov = 90.0;
    float f = 1.0 / tan(radians(fov) / 2.0);

    Ray ray;
    ray.origin = vec3(0.0);
    ray.dir = normalize(vec3(uv, -f));
    return ray;
}

mat3 rotateX(float a) {
    float c = cos(a), s = sin(a);
    return mat3(1, 0, 0, 0, c, -s, 0, s, c);
}

mat3 rotateY(float a) {
    float c = cos(a), s = sin(a);
    return mat3(c, 0, s, 0, 1, 0, -s, 0, c);
}

Ray orbitRay(Ray ray, float distance) {
    vec2 mouse = iMouse.xy / iResolution.xy;
    if (length(iMouse.xy) < 1.0) mouse = vec2(0.6, 0.55);

    float angleY = (mouse.x - 0.5) * 6.28;
    float angleX = (0.5 - mouse.y) * 3.14;

    mat3 rot = rotateX(angleX) * rotateY(angleY);
    ray.origin = rot * vec3(0.0, 0.0, distance);
    ray.dir = rot * ray.dir;
    return ray;
}

// --- Primitives ---

float sdPlane(vec3 p, float height) {
    return p.y - height;
}

#define PHI (0.5 + 0.5 * sqrt(5.0))

float sdIcosahedron(vec3 p, float r) {
    p = abs(p);
    float invPHI = PHI - 1.0;

    float d = p.x + p.y + p.z;
    d = max(d, p.y * invPHI + p.z * PHI);
    d = max(d, p.x * invPHI + p.y * PHI);
    d = max(d, p.x * PHI + p.z * invPHI);

    return d * 0.57735027 - r;
}

// --- Objects ---

struct Sphere {
    vec3 center;
    float radius;
    vec3 color;
};

struct Icosahedron {
    vec3 center;
    float size;
    vec3 color;
};

float sdf(vec3 p, Sphere s) {
    vec3 q = p - s.center;
    return length(q) - s.radius;
}

float sdf(vec3 p, Icosahedron ico) {
    return sdIcosahedron(p - ico.center, ico.size);
}

// --- Scene ---

Sphere ball = Sphere(vec3(-1.0, 0.0, 0.0), 0.8, vec3(0.2, 0.5, 0.9));
Icosahedron gem = Icosahedron(vec3(1.2, 0.0, 0.0), 0.7, vec3(0.9, 0.3, 0.2));

float sdScene(vec3 p) {
    float d = sdf(p, ball);
    d = min(d, sdf(p, gem));
    d = min(d, sdPlane(p, -0.8));
    return d;
}

vec3 getMaterial(vec3 p) {
    float eps = 0.01;

    if (sdf(p, ball) < eps) return ball.color;
    if (sdf(p, gem) < eps) return gem.color;
    if (sdPlane(p, -0.8) < eps) return vec3(0.35, 0.3, 0.3);

    return vec3(1.0, 0.0, 1.0);  // magenta = error
}

// --- Raymarching ---

vec3 calcNormal(vec3 p) {
    float eps = 0.001;
    return normalize(vec3(
        sdScene(p + vec3(eps, 0, 0)) - sdScene(p - vec3(eps, 0, 0)),
        sdScene(p + vec3(0, eps, 0)) - sdScene(p - vec3(0, eps, 0)),
        sdScene(p + vec3(0, 0, eps)) - sdScene(p - vec3(0, 0, eps))
    ));
}

float raymarch(Ray ray) {
    float t = 0.0;

    for (int i = 0; i < MAX_STEPS; i++) {
        vec3 p = ray.origin + t * ray.dir;
        float d = sdScene(p);

        if (d < HIT_THRESHOLD) return t;

        t += d;

        if (t > MAX_DIST) return -1.0;
    }

    return -1.0;
}

// --- Shading ---

vec3 shadeDiffuse(vec3 normal, vec3 albedo) {
    vec3 lightDir = normalize(vec3(1.0, 1.0, 1.0));
    float brightness = max(0.0, dot(normal, lightDir));
    return albedo * (0.15 + 0.85 * brightness);
}

void mainImage(out vec4 fragColor, in vec2 fragCoord) {
    Ray ray = makeRay(fragCoord);
    ray = orbitRay(ray, 6.0);

    float t = raymarch(ray);

    vec3 color = vec3(0.1, 0.1, 0.2);
    if (t > 0.0) {
        vec3 p = ray.origin + t * ray.dir;
        vec3 normal = calcNormal(p);
        vec3 material = getMaterial(p);
        color = shadeDiffuse(normal, material);
    }

    fragColor = vec4(color, 1.0);
}
```
